item.title: Cornell faculty vote no-confidence in leadership after gang rape case
item.description: Faculty members at Cornell University on Friday passed a no-confidence resolution against the elite college’s leadership over its handling of an alleged gang rape that has sparked outcry in the US. The vote is not binding but marks a strong symbolic rebuke of administrators at the Ivy League college in New York state. According to a lawsuit, a female student was assaulted by seven male students at a fraternity house on campus. Following her initial allegations in 2024, Cornell shut down the...

item.title: Ted Lieu seeks Congress leadership post, aiming to break another glass ceiling
item.description: California Democratic Congressman Ted Lieu is seeking to become the next chairman of the House Democratic Caucus, one of the top leadership jobs in the US Congress, and potentially making history again as the highest-ranking Asian-American on Capitol Hill. He announced his caucus chair candidacy in a letter to fellow Democrats on Thursday. He’s currently the most high-profile Asian and Chinese-American in Congress, serving as vice-chairman of the caucus, the fourth-ranking position in the House...

item.title: Can China champion the Global South without speaking for it?
item.description: Travelling through South America earlier this year, I was repeatedly reminded of China’s growing importance. item.title: California’s first Asian lieutenant governor traces roots to esteemed family in China
